scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n renderer,electron-main,desktop "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "tsc --project tsconfig.electron.json --watch" "wait-on tcp:5173 file:dist-electron/electron/main/main.js && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.build: npm run build:electron && npm run build:renderer
scripts.test:conversation-history: npm run build:electron && node --test test/conversation-history.test.cjs test/tool-activity-label.test.cjs
